scripts.build: npm run data:build && npm run build:ts
scripts.check: npm run check:ts && npm run check:python
scripts.check:python: uv run --locked ruff check pipeline tests/python scripts/check_site.py scripts/inspect_nisanyan.py && uv run --locked ty check pipeline tests/python scripts/check_site.py scripts/inspect_nisanyan.py
scripts.test: npm run build && uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests/python -v && node --test --test-isolation=none tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src 'tests/*.mjs' index.html style.css package.json tsconfig.json README.md && uv run --locked ruff format pipeline tests/python scripts/check_site.py scripts/inspect_nisanyan.py
